text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(Keep your eyes on me, world! Glory
belongs to
those who pursue it!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This is what true potential is! Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl exhibits some truly
exemplary running against the winner of
the Prix Jacques Le
Marois, Taiki
Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And she's won! Seeking the Pearl has
won the Mile
Championship against Taiki
Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's not only strong when it comes to 
1,200-meter races! We have ourselves
yet
another world-class ruler of the mile
right here!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant... Scintillating job, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... Pearl...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thanks... for inspiring me, and for being
my goal
to chase after.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You're the reason I'm able to shine like
this right
now.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Pearl... Today made me realize
somethin'. Y'know
what?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I reckon you were supposed to be the
first one to
win an international G1. I
mean, just look how
strong ya are.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I wonder. I don't know how true
that might
be...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But hearing the one who actually
managed to conquer the world say that
about me... That
makes me happier than
anything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of them praise each other

whole-heartedly. I give them some space
before
speaking up.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My speech?
choice_data_list: Now, Pearl, give us your message.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. I won, and now the floor
is mine.
choice_data_list: Yeah, to take on the world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And since I beat the reigning world
champion, all
eyes are on me right now.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mic check... One, two... Can you hear
me,
everyone?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Seeking the Pearl here! Did
you see
that win?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
As you all know, Taiki Shuttle is a racer
like no
other. The reason I won today...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Isn't because I'm stronger. It's because I
wholly
believed in my possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
People say that you can make any dream
come
true...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I don't agree with that. Some dreams
can't be
granted! But!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Even a dream that can be granted won't come true if you don't believe in it! Everyone, look into yourselves!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The answer to what you can do, and
what your
possibilities are, lies inside
you somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's what I wanted to show everyone
in the
world. I wanted to save you all...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But there were times when you were the
ones who
saved me instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"You were the ones who saved me
instead." I've
never heard her say that
before.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to do everything I could to
show you all your possibilities. That
unrelenting drive helped me get back on
my feet, no matter how difficult things
got.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My goal was the hope that kept me
going! It was
the shining, brilliant light
of a polished pearl!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And hope... is such a beautiful thing.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Are you listening, world? Every single
one of you
has power in you that you
haven't discovered yet.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's time to take a step forward from
where you
are now and fly, just as I've
shown you!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Each and every person in this world is
brimming
with possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I was born to show you that. I won to
show you
that! Thank you, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Young Asian Boy
text_block_list.text: Possibilities...

text_block_list.name: Young German Girl
text_block_list.text: Sie hat es geschafft... Possibilities...

text_block_list.name: Old Female Guide
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone is brimming with
possibilities..."
Goodness, is that the girl
who came on my tour?

text_block_list.name: Old Female Guide
text_block_list.text:
Why... I didn't realize I made such an
impact on
her...

text_block_list.name: Old Female Guide
text_block_list.text:
Who would've thought that ten years
later, I'd get
a pat on the back like this?

text_block_list.name: Young American Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
She beat Taiki Shuttle...
She really did it.

text_block_list.name: Young American Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl, was it? She's just like
me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just how far can this message from a
small island
in the east reach? It's
impossible to tell...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But Seeking the Pearl put her whole
heart and
soul into that race. I'm sure her
feelings came through loud and clear to
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Pearl! I got a question to ask ya!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I might've lost today, but I've still got
some
runnin' in me! So please!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we race together again next
year, a
million, billion times more on the
track?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taiki... Haha. That's so sweet of you to
ask.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But sorry, my answer's a "No"! ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! But why?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's because we still have
unfinished
business.
Don't we, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You might've gotten the jump on me,
but there's
something I still need to give
my best shot at too.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec! Are you talkin' about...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I still have to win myself a
European G1! So
our battle on the track
is going to have to wait. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll be going all over the world to meet
more of
the Pearl family next year! Wish
me luck!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I chase after her hurriedly as she walks
off.
Seeking the Pearl's quest for more is

never-ending.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now it's time to fulfill her destiny of
winning a European G1, with running
and skills that far
surpass that very
destiny.
